newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne sees Beaver Valley 2 nuke back Wed.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne sees Beaver Valley 2 nuke back Wed.

text.p: Duquesne Light Co said Tuesday the 833 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Beaver Valley nuclear generating station would synchronize to the power grid early Wednesday.
"Unit 2 is in startup mode...it's going to be on line tomorrow morning," said a company spokesman.
A recirculation pump seal problem at Beaver Valley 2 disrupted a restart attempt last weekend. The Shippingport, Pa., unit was originally shut a week ago due to an electrical relay problem.
The nearby 810 MW unit 1 was operating at full output.
Duquesne, a subsidiary of DQE Inc, operates and holds a partial stake in both Beaver Valley units.
Ohio Edison and Centerior Energy are the other owners of the units.
